name: AICommandCenterSlim
description: AICommandCenterSlim is a minimal single-row variant of the AI Command Center. The input lives in a pill-shaped bar — everything in one row. The right action button shows a microphone by default (talk-first); when the user types, the mic transitions to an ArrowUp send button with the AI gradient fill. No quick chips, no placeholder copy, no subtext. Intended for surfaces where the AI bar needs to coexist with other content rather than owning the full page.
intent: Compact single-line AI prompt bar for lightweight contexts. Adapts between idle and active modes without a full command center footprint.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

usage: Use when the AI bar shares space with other content on the page
Use for lightweight voice-or-text entry points that don't require a full command center
doNotUse: Do not use when quick-action chips are needed — use AICommandCenter instead
